from pathlib import Path
programs=Path(base)/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    if any(len(row) != n for row in grid):
        raise ValueError("expected a square grid")
    def rot90_cw(a):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    def rot90_ccw(a):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
    def rot180(a):
        return [row[::-1] for row in a[::-1]]
    blocks = [grid, rot90_cw(grid), rot90_ccw(grid), rot180(grid)]
    return [blocks[0][r] + blocks[1][r] for r in range(n)] + [blocks[2][r] + blocks[3][r] for r in range(n)]
'''
